lines: This plan covers 3 days, starting today.
Shopping and cooking first thing in the morning, so it is ready by lunch.
One shop, on Friday: everything this plan asks for keeps until it is cooked.
The shared base is vegan: that is Lea's line, and they have their own box. The rest of the table keeps theirs.
Everyone has every one of their meals.
The shares in this plan are served at the plate, as close as they can be, rather than adjusted mouth by mouth.

dishes.name: Garden tofu breakfast
dishes.title: Tofu scramble, toast and tomatoes
dishes.method: Reheat the shared tofu scramble, then add the toast and sliced tomato. The shared batch was made first on clean equipment and boxed before the separate dish was started.
dishes.why: A warm, protein-centred breakfast with fresh seasonal tomatoes.

dishes.name: Theo's egg breakfast
dishes.title: Scrambled eggs, toast and tomatoes

dishes.why: A simple breakfast that keeps the morning meal regular.

preparations.title: Tofu scramble
preparations.method: Prepare the shared tofu scramble first on clean equipment, cook the onions and mushrooms in olive oil, crumble in tofu, fold through spinach, season, and portion into the named boxes before any other batch is opened.

preparations.title: Lentil tomato sauce
preparations.method: Cook the onions, carrots and garlic in olive oil, add tomatoes and oregano, simmer until thick, stir in the cooked lentils, and portion into the named boxes. Cool promptly and refrigerate.

preparations.title: Scrambled eggs
preparations.method: After the shared batches are closed, wash the board, knife and pan, use fresh oil, cook the eggs, stir through chives, and portion with a dedicated spoon into Theo's closed boxes.

preparations.title: Beef tomato sauce
preparations.method: After washing the equipment and closing the shared boxes, cook the beef with onion, carrot and garlic in fresh oil, add tomatoes, simmer until cooked through, and portion with a dedicated spoon.

preparations.title: Roasted chickpeas and vegetables
preparations.method: Heat the oven, chop the vegetables, toss them with chickpeas, olive oil and paprika, roast until tender, then portion into the named boxes.

preparations.title: Roast chicken
preparations.method: After the shared vegetable tray is portioned and closed, wash the equipment, use fresh oil, season the chicken with lemon and thyme, roast until cooked through, and portion with a dedicated spoon into Theo's closed boxes.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Buy the fresh ingredients today or the day before. Heat the oven and prepare the tofu scramble first; portion it into the shared breakfast boxes and close them. Start the lentil sauce while the oven heats. Roast the chickpea vegetables, then portion and close the shared dinner boxes. Wash the board, knife and pan, use fresh oil, cook Theo's eggs and beef sauce separately, then wash again before cooking the chicken; use a dedicated spoon for each separate batch and portion everything into the named boxes.
